silhouette.evidence: Non-mammal plans (frog, spider, ant, bird, fish) have clear distinct silhouettes in lineup_v2.png; mammals collapse into near-identical elongated lizard shapes.

palette.evidence: Heritable palette is clamped to a dusk-watercolour gamut (Ink.palette); lineup_v2.png shows harmonious olive, rust, slate with violet shadows, no garish outliers.

readability.evidence: At lineup scale the vole, hare, gnawer, mole and squirrel are hard to tell apart; heads and ears are tiny dots and white whisker strokes.

cohesion.evidence: Shared outline weight, hue-shifted shading and cast shadow unify all 15 animals in lineup_v2.png.

distinctiveness.evidence: Illuminated-bestiary look is its own, but the mammal row repeats one template with a different tail.

technical.evidence: No per-output deterministic render check exists; only phenotype determinism is unit-tested.
